name: situations
items: A meeting starts in ten minutes, and the agenda still feels unclear.
An email from a manager sounds tense, and the right reply is hard to find.
A spreadsheet total does not match the figures in the monthly report.
A job interview is tomorrow, and confidence is starting to slip.
A presentation slide is crowded with text just before the review.
A colleague used an unfamiliar acronym during a call.
A project deadline moved forward without warning.
A customer complaint needs a calm response before the end of the day.
A résumé feels dated after years in the same role.
A difficult workplace conversation keeps replaying after hours.
An assignment prompt makes little sense on the first reading.
An exam is approaching, but one concept still will not click.
A blank page has stayed blank for half an hour.
Class notes are messy and incomplete after a rushed lecture.
A child asks a homework question that the parent has forgotten how to answer.
A research article is dense with unfamiliar terminology.
A study schedule has fallen apart after several busy days.
Two sources appear to contradict each other.
A foreign-language sentence looks correct but sounds unnatural.
A group project needs everyone’s ideas combined into one coherent draft.
Dinner must be made from whatever is left in the refrigerator.
A toddler refuses every activity on a rainy afternoon.
A family gathering needs to accommodate several dietary preferences.
A bedtime story has been requested with very specific characters.
An elderly relative received a confusing letter in the mail.
A sibling’s birthday is close, but no gift feels personal enough.
The household calendar has become a maze of overlapping commitments.
A child is nervous about starting at a new school.
A family disagreement needs a message that will not inflame things.
Unexpected guests are arriving in an hour.
An insurance form asks for information that is difficult to locate.
A dental appointment needs to fit around work and school pickups.
A clinic sent preparation instructions full of administrative jargon.
A prescription reimbursement claim was returned without a clear explanation.
Several health-related receipts need to be organized for reimbursement.
A vaccination record is required for enrollment, but the process is unclear.
A caregiver needs a concise list of questions for an upcoming appointment.
A benefits portal shows an unfamiliar status beside a submitted claim.
A medical bill appears to include the same charge twice.
A wellness appointment is due, but nobody remembers when the last one occurred.
The bank balance is lower than expected a week before payday.
A subscription renewed even though it is barely used.
A household budget no longer reflects current grocery prices.
A utility bill suddenly increased without an obvious reason.
Two loan offers look similar but hide different costs.
A tax notice arrived with a deadline buried in dense wording.
A couple needs a fair way to divide shared expenses.
A freelance payment is overdue, and a reminder must stay professional.
A savings goal feels impossible at the current monthly pace.
A purchase seems tempting, but the discount may not be as good as it looks.
The landlord sent a lease renewal with several changed clauses.
A dripping tap has become impossible to ignore.
A small room needs to work as both a bedroom and an office.
A neighbor’s noise is affecting sleep, but confrontation feels awkward.
A moving date is near, and the packing still looks overwhelming.
A stain appeared on the wall after heavy rain.
A rental listing seems unusually cheap for the area.
Furniture measurements may not fit through the stairwell.
A security deposit has not been returned after moving out.
The heating system has an unfamiliar warning light.
A flight was changed, breaking every later connection.
A weekend trip is possible, but the forecast keeps shifting.
A train ticket has restrictions written in another language.
A suitcase is nearly full before the essentials are packed.
A long layover needs to be made bearable on a limited budget.
A visitor wants a quiet local place away from the usual attractions.
A passport requirement seems different across two official pages.
A road trip needs a sensible stopping point before nightfall.
A traveler feels uneasy about navigating an unfamiliar airport alone.
A hotel cancellation policy is harder to understand than expected.
A half-finished knitting project no longer matches its pattern.
A guitar chord sounds wrong despite repeated practice.
A gardener needs plants that can survive a shaded balcony.
A recipe calls for an ingredient unavailable nearby.
A board-game rule causes an argument halfway through playing.
A camera’s manual settings are producing consistently dark photos.
A runner wants a varied route without adding much distance.
A book club meeting is tonight, and the ending remains confusing.
A home craft needs a safe substitute for a missing material.
A new hobby looks exciting but the equipment list seems excessive.
A government letter demands a response by an unfamiliar procedure.
An online application keeps rejecting a correctly formatted address.
A permit renewal requires documents scattered across several folders.
A municipal website sends the user in circles between the same pages.
A form asks for a category that does not seem to fit the situation.
An official appointment is available only during working hours.
A certificate must be requested from an office with unclear instructions.
A residency application needs proof covering several past years.
A parking fine seems inconsistent with the signs at the location.
A public-service phone menu never reaches the relevant department.
A friend has gone quiet after an awkward conversation.
A partner’s message can be read in two very different ways.
Someone wants to apologize without making excuses.
A first date is approaching after a long break from dating.
A relative keeps crossing a boundary that has already been explained.
A friendship feels one-sided, but ending it seems too drastic.
A thoughtful condolence message is needed for someone not known very well.
A roommate discussion about chores has become emotionally charged.
Someone wants to decline an invitation without sounding dismissive.
A loved one is going through a hard week, and ordinary reassurance feels inadequate.
The laptop became extremely slow after a software update.
A phone has stopped backing up photos.
The printer insists it is offline while sitting beside the router.
A password manager contains several duplicate accounts.
A video call microphone works everywhere except one application.
A suspicious message appears to come from a familiar company.
A smart television keeps disconnecting from Wi-Fi.
A document’s formatting changes whenever it is exported.
Cloud storage is full, but deleting anything feels risky.
An old device must be prepared before being given to someone else.
A neighborhood event needs an announcement that welcomes everyone.
Volunteers have offered help, but nobody knows who is doing what.
A local meeting became heated over a minor proposal.
A community garden has more interested residents than available plots.
A charity collection needs a transparent way to report what was received.
A school fundraiser is approaching with very few sign-ups.
A shared building notice must be understandable to residents speaking different languages.
A lost pet was spotted nearby, but the details are uncertain.
A local club wants fresh ideas after attendance declined.
A neighbor may need help, but it is unclear how to offer without intruding.
Three important deadlines landed in the same week.
A reminder was missed, and a late submission now needs an explanation.
An unfamiliar object found in a drawer sparks sudden curiosity.
A news headline mentions a concept everyone else seems to understand.
A strange sound at night causes worry, though nothing obvious is wrong.
Waiting alone at an airport gate has become painfully boring.
A minor mistake keeps growing larger in the imagination.
An empty Sunday afternoon needs something engaging but inexpensive.
A late-night question feels too small to ask another person.
Someone cannot sleep because tomorrow’s responsibilities keep circling in their mind.
